stays.name: Playce Camp Jeju
stays.note: Design hotel in Seongsan built around a courtyard of cafés and shops. Ilchulbong is a 5-minute drive.

stays.name: Jeju Shinhwa World Marriott Resort
stays.note: Resort at Jeju Shinhwa World in Andeok, on the southwest side. Platinum late checkout on Tue 20 Oct if you want a slow morning.

stays.name: Sheraton Jeju Hotel
stays.note: New hotel on the Tapdong seafront in Jeju City (formerly the Ramada Plaza), about 10 minutes from the airport.

cars.note: Booked to Wed 07:00; the plan returns it on Tuesday afternoon.

days.title: Stone Park, two folk villages, sunset by Ilchulbong
days.note: A red-eye in, so the day has a break built in: check in and rest before sunset, then pick an easy beach view or the Ilchulbong climb depending on how you feel.

stops.name: Land on TW166
stops.note: Immigration and bags first. Then leave arrivals by Gate 5 and cross to the rental car shuttle stops: LOTTE's free bus leaves from Zone 1, stop 4, about every 7 minutes.

stops.name: Pick up the car at LOTTE Jeju Autohouse
stops.note: Your Hyundai Avante is booked and paid. Bring passports, licences, International Driving Permits and a credit or debit card (LOTTE takes no cash). If you've done LOTTE's online pre-check-in, scan its QR code on the shuttle; if not, use the self check-in kiosk at the branch. Photograph the car and the fuel gauge before you drive off. Branch phone: 064-751-8000.

options.name: Owners One
options.dish: Hand-drip filter coffee or a latte
options.tip: On Bijarim-ro, a few minutes from Stone Park.
options.why: Naver 4.91 from 564 reviews; 518 of them say the coffee is great, and the view gets a mention too.

options.name: Yeonu Café
options.dish: Udo peanut cream latte or Jeju matcha cream latte
options.tip: Opens at 07:00, so it works even if you get the car early. It's by the Gyorae lunch spots.
options.why: Naver 4.64 from 815 reviews; reviewers rate the coffee, the interior and the desserts.

stops.name: Jeju Stone Park & Stone Museum
stops.note: Jeju's creation myths told in basalt: a large outdoor park of stone statues and dol hareubang, with the Stone Museum inside. Open 09:00 to 18:00, last tickets 17:00; closed on Mondays.
stops.weather: Mostly outdoor, so in rain cut the visit down to the indoor Stone Museum, or use the 4·3 Peace Park 3.9 km away.

stops.name: Lunch in Gyorae
stops.note: Gyorae village, next to Stone Park, is known for Jeju native chicken (tojongdak).

options.name: Seongmi Garden
options.dish: Chicken shabu-shabu, then baeksuk and mung-bean porridge
options.tip: Phone 064-783-7092 an hour or more ahead to book and pre-order the course; baeksuk is slow to cook.
options.why: Gyorae's best-known native-chicken house, called resident-endorsed in 2026 blogs; Naver 4.42 from 1,354 reviews.

options.name: Gyorae Gotjawal Son-kalguksu
options.dish: Native-chicken kalguksu (hand-cut noodle soup)
options.tip: The quick chicken option, about 30 minutes at the table; the ₩17,000 mung-bean pancake is made to share.
options.why: Naver 4.4 from 1,124 reviews and Diningcode 78 (4.6 from 13), against 69 for the rival shop across the road.

options.name: Gakjibul
options.dish: Perilla-seed monkfish stew (agu-tang)
options.tip: 3 km south on the road to Seongeup, so it suits the drive on; it closes early once ingredients run out.
options.why: Diningcode 84 (4.8 from 13), the top Diningcode score for a Gyorae-ri restaurant; Naver 4.49 from 855 reviews.

options.name: Udon Kaden
options.dish: Zaru udon or tempura udon
options.tip: The quick non-chicken lunch, and pork-free; the hairtail tempura (₩34,000) is an extra to share.
options.why: Naver 4.03 from 3,719 reviews, the most-reviewed Gyorae place checked; Diningcode 77 (4.3 from 30).

options.name: Gyorae Pongnang
options.dish: Pongnang set meal of Jeju home cooking
options.tip: The set needs two diners; momguk is pork-based, but the fish braises and sea-urchin soup are not.
options.why: Naver 4.56 from 1,008 reviews; Naver's summary praises its black-pork suyuk with anchovy braise.

stops.name: Seongeup Folk Village
stops.note: A lived-in village of thatched stone houses, black stone walls and dol hareubang statues. Free to walk around. Some residents offer free tours that end with a sales pitch; it's fine to say no.
stops.weather: An open-air folk village, so rain makes it a wet walk; in heavy rain use the 4·3 Peace Park or Seonnyeo and Namukkun instead.

stops.name: Jeju Folk Village
stops.note: An open-air museum of more than 100 traditional Jeju houses by the sea. Open 08:30 to 18:00 in October, last entry 17:00. If you're flagging, skip it; it's a lot like Seongeup.
stops.weather: An open-air folk village, so rain affects the whole visit; in rain spend the afternoon at one of the indoor stops near Seongsan.

stops.name: Check in, afternoon coffee and rest
stops.note: ttt COFFEE in the hotel courtyard (the old Dorell Coffee flagship) is open until 17:00, so get your coffee first, then rest before sunset.

stops.name: Sunset: pick your energy level
stops.note: Sunset is just before 6 pm. The beach is a flat walk from the hotel; the climb is the classic view, but it's stairs all the way. In rain or low cloud, skip both and rest.

options.name: Gwangchigi Beach, the easy option
options.dish: Sunset light on Ilchulbong from the beach
options.tip: A flat 10-minute walk from Playce Camp, or a 2-minute drive to the beach car park.
options.why: Your saved Ilchulbong view with no stairs after a red-eye; the peak catches the last light across the beach.

options.name: Seongsan Ilchulbong climb
options.dish: Stairs to the crater rim for sunset
options.tip: Start up by 17:25; the stairs take 20 to 40 minutes. Bring a torch for the way down.
options.why: The classic Jeju sunset from the rim, if you still have the energy after the red-eye.

stops.name: Dinner in Seongsan
stops.note: Most places in Seongsan take last orders by 20:00 to 21:00.

options.name: Buchon
options.dish: Galchi-jorim set with sea-urchin seaweed soup
options.tip: 190 m from Playce Camp, so walk; sets are per person, with no 2-serving minimum listed.
options.why: Naver 4.49 from 2,288 reviews and Diningcode 79 (4.5 from 39); the 20:00 last order leaves slack after the hike.

options.name: Danbaek
options.dish: Black-pork neck, 250 g per person
options.tip: The listing asks guests to book on Naver before visiting; it's 360 m from Playce Camp.
options.why: Naver 4.95 from 2,676 reviews, the highest of any Seongsan restaurant checked; Diningcode 73 (4.7 from 8).

options.name: Gasiabang Guksu
options.dish: Gogi-guksu (pork noodle soup) and sliced dombe-gogi
options.tip: Last order is about 19:40, so drive straight over; its Naver page links Catchtable for the waitlist.
options.why: Naver 4.34 from 4,460 reviews; the pork-noodle and dombe-gogi option, 1.3 km from Playce Camp.

options.name: Samsujeong Sikdang
options.dish: Black-pork mixed platter, or Hanwoo sirloin
options.tip: 310 m from Playce Camp and taking orders until 21:00, so it's the safe fallback if the hike runs late.
options.why: Diningcode 67 (4.6) and 773 Naver reviews; a walkable black-pork and Hanwoo house that stays open late.

options.name: Asi Hoetjip
options.dish: Mackerel sashimi and deep-sea shrimp couple set
options.tip: By Ilchulbong, 2 km from the hotel, so you can eat straight after the sunset hike before driving back.
options.why: 5,734 Naver reviews and Diningcode 75 (4.2); the sashimi choice in Seongsan, open until 22:00.

stops.name: Tapau tomorrow's breakfast at 7-Eleven
stops.note: 130 m from the hotel and open 07:00 to midnight. Good grab-and-go picks: triangle kimbap, sandwiches, boiled eggs, banana milk and bottled or hot coffee. For bakery bread instead, Boryong Jegwa (보룡제과) is 390 m away and open until 22:00.

planB.name: Jeju 4·3 Peace Park and Memorial Hall
planB.note: Indoor memorial museum 3.9 km from Stone Park, with free entry and parking. It can also stand in for Seongeup in heavy rain.

planB.name: Jeju Haenyeo Museum
planB.note: Museum of Jeju's women divers, 10.2 km from Ilchulbong, for 1,100 KRW. It is also Sunday's fallback if the haenyeo show is off.

planB.name: Bunker de Lumières
planB.note: Immersive Van Gogh and Gauguin projection shows 4.4 km from Ilchulbong. No end dates are published, so check they are still running: 1522-2653.

planB.name: Aqua Planet Jeju
planB.note: Large aquarium 3.2 km from Ilchulbong; allow 2-3 hours. Price unverified: 44,600 KRW all-inclusive, with online deals from about 39,700 KRW.

planB.name: Seonnyeo and Namukkun Theme Park
planB.note: Korean nostalgia theme park 5.2 km from Stone Park, best as an extra stop. Price unverified.

days.title: Udo, the haenyeo show and a tangerine café
days.note: Udo in the morning, back for the haenyeo show, then a tangerine café on the drive west. You're at the resort by about 5 pm, with time to rest before dinner and shopping.

stops.name: Breakfast in the room
stops.note: Last night's tapau from the 7-Eleven. Nothing at Playce Camp opens before 08:00, but the 7-Eleven opens at 07:00 if you forgot.

stops.name: Ferry to Udo
stops.note: Ferries leave Seongsan Port about every 30 minutes from 07:30 and cross in about 15 minutes. Rental cars can't go across, so park here. Every passenger fills in a boarding form: bring passports.
stops.weather: A wind-wave advisory can cut the timetable (on 18 Sep 2026 boats ran only until 17:00) or stop it; call 064-782-5670 or 064-782-5671 before going.

stops.name: Seobin Baeksa beach
stops.note: Rent an e-bike or electric buggy at the pier first (bring your driving licence and IDP). This beach's white 'coral' sand is actually rhodoliths, round lumps of red algae, which is why the water glows turquoise.

stops.name: Morning coffee at Hagosudong Beach
stops.note: Shallow turquoise water on the northeast shore. Blanc Rocher (블랑로쉐) opens at 10:00 for coffee, including a peanut-cream latte (₩8,900), and Udo's famous peanut ice cream. Dalkom Ajae (달콤아재), opposite the beach, opens at 09:00 at weekends.

stops.name: Udobong, the lighthouse and Geommeolle Beach
stops.note: Walk up the grassy cone to the lighthouse park for views back to Ilchulbong, then down to Geommeolle, the black-sand cove right below; at low tide you can walk into the sea cave at its far end. Skip the climb if your legs are done from yesterday.

stops.name: Lunch on Udo
stops.note: Return the e-bike at Cheonjin Port before the ferry.

options.name: Soseom Jeonbok
options.dish: Abalone rice with abalone hotpot, seaweed soup or mulhoe
options.tip: Jimmy's peanut ice cream is about 300 m away, so pair the two before riding to the Cheonjin ferry.
options.why: Naver 4.67 from 2,677 reviews; the well-rated meal nearest Geommeolle and Udobong, 1.6 km from Cheonjin port.

options.name: Pungwon
options.dish: Squid jumulleok, then Hallasan fried rice
options.tip: By the Haumokdong pier, 1.9 km north of Cheonjin port, so leave time to ride back for the ferry.
options.why: Naver 4.81 from 5,256 reviews, the top Naver score of the Udo restaurants checked; Diningcode 79 (4.4 from 23).

options.name: Jimmy's Natural Ice Cream
options.dish: Original Udo peanut ice cream
options.tip: At Geommeolle, about 300 m from Soseom Jeonbok, so have it after lunch on the way to Cheonjin port.
options.why: The peanut ice cream stop by Geommeolle, billed as the original; 1,388 Naver reviews, Diningcode 73 (3.8 from 26).

options.name: Udo Mooldeuri Haenyeo-ui-jip
options.dish: Top-shell hijiki kalguksu or octopus-abalone ramyeon
options.tip: On the north coast, 3.5 km from Cheonjin port, so only if you're on that side at noon; it can sell out.
options.why: Diningcode 78 (4.8 from 12), the top result for Udo seafood ramyeon; Naver 4.65 from 4,286 reviews.

stops.name: Ferry back to Seongsan Port
stops.note: Check the return times when you buy your ticket.
stops.weather: A wind-wave advisory can cut the timetable (on 18 Sep 2026 boats ran only until 17:00) or stop it; call 064-782-5670 or 064-782-5671 before going.

stops.name: Haenyeo diving show
stops.note: Jeju's women free-divers perform on the shore at the east foot of Ilchulbong, next to the haenyeo house (해녀의집). Recent Naver posts (Aug-Sep 2026) say it now runs once a day at 14:00; older listings say 13:30 and 15:00. Be there by 13:30, or phone 064-783-0959 to confirm. Free, about 20 minutes, cancelled in bad weather.
stops.weather: High wind or rough seas cancel the show, so if the Udo ferry is cut back assume it is off; confirm around 12:30 on 064-783-0959.

stops.name: Afternoon coffee at Gyul Han Pyeon
stops.note: A tangerine café on the 516 road above Seogwipo, open Sunday 10:00 to 18:00 (closed Mondays). Café latte ₩5,000, or try the signature tangerine drink (₩7,500). Picking is ₩10,000 for a 2 kg basket, cash only, but it may not have started by 18 Oct: check their Instagram (@gyul_han_pyeon) or call 064-767-0516 a few days before.

stops.name: Check in and rest
stops.note: Home for 2 nights. Pool or a nap before dinner.

stops.name: Dinner at the resort
stops.note: The first four are inside Shinhwa World, a few minutes' walk from the Marriott, so nobody has to drive.

options.name: Hwasan
options.dish: Aged black-pork mixed platter, grilled by staff
options.tip: Staff grill at every table and there's no break; the platter's weight isn't listed, so ask before ordering.
options.why: Naver 4.76 from 4,349 reviews and Kakao 4.6 from 572, the best Kakao score of the restaurants inside the resort.

options.name: Pungno
options.dish: Aged Jeju pork (600 g set), grilled by staff
options.tip: Staff grill all the meat; Hanwoo sirloin (300 g, ₩118,000) covers anyone not eating pork.
options.why: Naver 4.87 from 4,901 reviews, the top Naver score in the resort, though Kakao gives it only 3.8 from 44.

options.name: Hallawon
options.dish: Galbitang (beef-rib soup), grilled mackerel or bibimbap
options.tip: Straw-smoked black pork is here too; the 2-person kimchi-jjim and jeyuk sets are lunch-only.
options.why: Naver 4.59 from 5,492 reviews, the most-reviewed restaurant in the resort, and Kakao 4.3 from 288.

options.name: Jejuseon
options.dish: Nangpun Jeju set meal, or vegetarian stone-pot bibimbap
options.tip: On the Marriott's G floor; last order 20:30. Jejuseon The Black on the same floor is closed, so don't mix them up.
options.why: Naver 4.31 from 725 reviews and Kakao 3.8 from 22; rated lower, but it's the resort's non-pork, vegetarian-friendly choice.

options.name: Gogitsori
options.dish: Charcoal-grilled black-pork platter; LA galbi for beef
options.tip: 3.6 km from the hotel in a straight line, so you'll drive and the driver can't drink. For beef, the top-grade (1++) striploin is ₩42,000.
options.why: Naver 4.88 from 715 reviews, the top Naver score within 4 km of the hotel, though Kakao gives only 4.0 from 31.

stops.name: Night shopping near the hotel
stops.note: The shops inside the resort close at 21:00 on Sunday, so go straight after dinner.

options.name: Shinsegae Simon Premium Store
options.dish: Brand-name shopping inside the resort
options.tip: Walkable from the Marriott and shuts at 21:00; for a mart as well, Daejeong Hanaro and Daiso stay open later.
options.why: No rating was collected; Kakao lists it at daily 10:30–21:00, the only shop in the resort with verified evening hours.

options.name: Andeok Nonghyup Hanaro Mart
options.dish: Jeju produce, tangerine snacks and groceries
options.tip: About 12 minutes' drive to Hwasun; arrive by 20:30 at the latest, since it closes at 21:00.
options.why: Kakao 4.4 from 67 ratings, higher than the Daejeong mart, and it has a local-food store for Jeju produce.

options.name: Daejeong Nonghyup Hanaro Mart
options.dish: Groceries, snacks and drinks
options.tip: Daiso Moseulpo is 1.4 km further west on the same road (Iljuseo-ro), so both fit in one trip.
options.why: Kakao 4.1 from 51 ratings; it closes at 21:30, later than the Andeok and Jungmun Hanaro marts.

options.name: Daiso Moseulpo
options.dish: Low-cost household goods and travel basics
options.tip: About 15–20 minutes' drive; open until 22:00, so it's the one to pick if dinner runs late.
options.why: No rating was collected; Kakao shows daily 10:00–22:00, the latest verified closing within about 20 minutes' drive.

options.name: Olive Young Jungmun
options.dish: Korean cosmetics and skincare
options.tip: About 15–20 minutes east in Jungmun, the opposite way from Daiso and the Daejeong mart; it closes at 21:00.
options.why: No rating was collected; Kakao shows daily 10:00–21:00, and it's the only cosmetics shop checked that's open Sunday evening.

planB.name: Ojo Haenyeo-ui-jip (abalone porridge)
planB.note: A hot breakfast on the road: abalone porridge from 07:00, on the way to the port. Leave the hotel at 07:00 and take your toilet time at the port terminal instead; you'd still make the same ferry.

planB.name: Aqua Planet Jeju
planB.note: Fills the morning 5 km from Seongsan Port and opens at 09:30. Price unverified (44,600 KRW); Bunker de Lumières, also 5 km away, costs 19,000 and opens at 10:00.

planB.name: Seogwipo Citrus Museum
planB.note: Indoor tangerine museum 2.1 km from Cafe Gyul Han Pyeon. Its own picking runs only November to January, so there is none on 18 Oct. Tel 064-760-6400.

planB.name: Jeju Haenyeo Museum
planB.note: Open on Sunday, 10 km from the show site, and covers the same subject indoors for 1,100 KRW.

planB.name: Hueree Nature Park
planB.note: Lists picking October to January for an extra fee (amount not found), 4.6 km from Gyul Han Pyeon. Call on Saturday to check it has started: 064-732-2114.

days.title: Bonte, tea fields, Songaksan and a windmill sunset
days.note: Everything is within 35 minutes of the resort. Sunset on the windmill coast is just before 6 pm.

stops.name: Morning coffee at Cafe Bonte
stops.note: The café in the Bonte Museum grounds, open 10:00 to 18:00. Americano ₩6,000.

stops.name: Bonte Museum
stops.note: A Tadao Ando building with traditional Korean crafts and contemporary art, including works by Yayoi Kusama. Open 10:00 to 18:00, last entry 17:00; adult tickets about ₩30,000.

stops.name: O'sulloc Tea Museum
stops.note: Free entry. Walk the green tea fields behind the museum and try the green tea roll cake. Innisfree Jeju House is next door.

options.name: Miyoung-ine
options.dish: Mackerel sashimi with the house mackerel stew
options.tip: If there's a queue, Manseon next door serves the same dish; ignore old listings that say it shuts Mondays.
options.why: Naver 4.53 from 4,381 reviews and Kakao 4.3 from 567; the most-reviewed mackerel-sashimi specialist at Moseulpo port.

options.name: Manseon Sikdang
options.dish: Mackerel sashimi, or mackerel with deep-sea shrimp
options.tip: Next door to Miyoung-ine, so take whichever has the shorter queue; neither takes Naver bookings.
options.why: Naver 4.56 from 2,082 reviews, a touch above Miyoung-ine, and Kakao 4.3 from 178 for the same dish.

options.name: Hanggu Sikdang
options.dish: Per-person mixed sashimi course
options.tip: Priced per person, so there's no big platter to share; the ₩15,000 raw-fish rice bowl suits a lighter eater.
options.why: Kakao 4.4 from 133 ratings and Naver 4.34 from 768 reviews; featured on KBS 2TV Saengsaeng Jeongbo.

options.name: Beonne Sikdang
options.dish: Boneless hairtail jorim and sea-urchin seaweed soup
options.tip: Lunch only and it sells out, so check Naver that morning; it's east of Hwasun, a detour from Moseulpo.
options.why: Naver 4.81 from 10,623 reviews, the best-rated galchi on this route and a locals' favourite with no raw fish.

options.name: Okdom Sikdang
options.dish: Top-shell and abalone hand-cut noodle soup
options.tip: A one-dish shop that closes when it sells out; phone ahead, as the shop itself suggests.
options.why: Naver 4.37 from 1,736 reviews; a cheap, quick lunch near Moseulpo port with no raw fish.

stops.name: Songaksan Viewpoint
stops.note: An easy clifftop loop of about an hour, with views of Sanbangsan, the Hyeongjeseom islets and, on clear days, Marado.
stops.weather: The coastal loop runs along cliff tops, so strong wind is the main hazard; the summit is closed until 31 Jul 2027 whatever the weather.

options.name: Take Time Coffee Roasters
options.dish: Americano or vanilla latte
options.tip: On the windmill coast road and open until 19:30, so you can stay for sunset; Klang Bleu is next door.
options.why: Kakao 4.8 from 58 ratings and 296 blog reviews; the best fit here for a stop that runs on into sunset.

options.name: Klang Bleu
options.dish: Udo peanut latte and a matcha roll cake
options.tip: Its framed window looks straight at the windmill beach; Take Time next door is the backup if it's full.
options.why: A travel article singles out its picture-frame view of the Sinchang windmills; 196 blog reviews, Diningcode 4.1.

options.name: Green Gureum
options.dish: Cloud coffee or peanut cream latte
options.tip: About 500 m down the same coast road; the quieter choice if Take Time and Klang Bleu are busy.
options.why: Kakao 4.9 from 29 ratings, the highest Kakao score of the windmill-coast cafés checked; 59 blog reviews.

options.name: 3rd-Person Observer's View
options.dish: Latte or ade
options.tip: Closes at 18:00, so it suits this stop but not a coffee after sunset.
options.why: Diningcode 4.9 on its Sinchang windmill-road café list; 122 blog reviews (Kakao rating hidden).

options.name: West Ground
options.dish: Apple-mango bingsu to share
options.tip: 2 km inland with no sea view, and it closes at 18:00, so go before the sunset stop.
options.why: Kakao 4.7 from 70 ratings and 455 blog reviews, the most blog reviews of the cafés near the windmills.

stops.name: Sunset on the Sinchang windmill coast
stops.note: Wind turbines stand along the shore and in the sea. Park near Singyemul Park and walk the boardwalk out over the water for sunset.
stops.weather: Cloud or rain removes the sunset, which is the reason to go; spend the time at Hallim Park and return via the resort's indoor facilities.

options.name: Badareul Bon Dwaeji
options.dish: Black-pork set for 2 (550 g) with free anchovy stew
options.tip: 2.8 km from the windmills and open until 22:00 every day, so there's no rush after sunset.
options.why: Kakao 4.1 from 161 ratings and 844 blog reviews; the closest of these dinners to the windmills.

options.name: Jeju Hyeopjae-ri Sikdang
options.dish: Grilled hairtail or mackerel set
options.tip: About 8 km north of the windmills near Hyeopjae; sets are priced per person, so you can each pick a fish.
options.why: Kakao 4.8 from 501 ratings, the strongest Kakao record of the Hallim and Hangyeong dinners, and the pork-free pick.

options.name: Hangyeong Garden
options.dish: Boneless galchi-jorim for 2
options.tip: Last order is 19:00, so drive straight here after sunset; it's 4.8 km south of the windmills.
options.why: Kakao 4.1 from 96 ratings and 447 blog reviews; Siksin lists it as a Hangyeong local pick.

options.name: Geumneung Gogitjip
options.dish: Thick-cut black pork (geun-gogi), 600 g
options.tip: It closes early when it sells out, so don't leave it late; it's 6.3 km from the windmills.
options.why: Kakao 4.8 from 129 ratings, the joint-top Kakao score among the Hallim black-pork houses checked.

options.name: Hwasan (Shinhwa World)
options.dish: Aged black-pork platter, grilled at the table by staff
options.tip: In the resort, 0.4 km from the Marriott and open until 23:30, so it's the pick if you'd rather drive back first.
options.why: Naver 4.76 from 4,349 reviews and Kakao 4.6 from 572, rated highly on both maps.

planB.name: Sanbangsan Carbonated Hot Spring
planB.note: Indoor baths 5.6 km from Songaksan, with a 4-hour limit. Outdoor baths are mixed and need swimwear (+5,000 KRW, rental 2,000). Tel 064-792-8300.

planB.name: Figure Museum Jeju
planB.note: Privately run, so it is open on the 3rd Monday when public museums close. 4.2 km from Bonte and rated 4.5 on Kakao.

planB.name: Arte Museum Jeju
planB.note: Immersive media art open until 20:00, so it can fill the sunset slot. About 10-11 km from the resort, O'sulloc and Bonte.

planB.name: Hallim Park
planB.note: 8.2 km from Sinchang, but mostly outdoor; the lava caves are the covered part. Sources disagree on price (12,000 or 15,000 KRW) and last entry (possibly 16:30).

planB.name: Jeju Ein Tangerine Farm Café
planB.note: Picking Oct-Dec if the harvest allows; a drink order (juice 7,500 KRW) gets you into the orchard. Closed Sundays, so Monday is the backup day. Tel 010-2822-1787.

days.title: Jusangjeolli, Cheonjiyeon, Aewol and Jeju City
days.note: A slow breakfast, then the Jusangjeolli cliffs and Cheonjiyeon waterfall, lunch at Olle Market in Seogwipo and cafés in Aewol. The car goes back on the way into Jeju City, and the evening is on foot.

stops.name: Toilet time, then check out
stops.note: Your platinum late checkout is there if you'd rather have a slow morning; the rest of the day just shifts later.

stops.name: Jusangjeolli Cliff
stops.note: Hexagonal basalt columns stacked along the shore; a short boardwalk, so it's an easy stop. Last entry 17:30.
stops.weather: Access can be closed in bad weather, and in rough seas waves shoot 20 m or more up the columns; check on 064-738-1521.

options.name: Jungmun Byeoljang
options.dish: The signature Byeoljang latte, or a coffee omakase
options.tip: The coffee omakase needs a reservation on Naver; the lattes don't.
options.why: Naver 4.92 from 14,361 reviews, and 13,520 of them say the coffee is great.

options.name: Café Onol
options.dish: Signature latte, or Jeju apple-mango bingsu to share
options.tip: The closest to Jusangjeolli, about 1 km east.
options.why: Naver 4.89 from 6,042 reviews, best known for its desserts and the view.

options.name: Mano Coffee House
options.dish: Hand-drip specialty coffee
options.tip: For coffee nerds: rare single origins run up to a ₩30,000 geisha.
options.why: Naver 4.76 from 698 reviews, known for careful hand-drip coffee.

stops.name: Cheonjiyeon Waterfall
stops.note: A flat 10-minute walk through a gorge to a 22 m waterfall. Open 09:00 to 22:00.
stops.weather: No weather closure is listed and the path is short and paved, so an umbrella is enough in light rain. In heavy rain, go straight to the covered Olle Market.

stops.name: Lunch at Olle Market, Seogwipo
stops.note: Seogwipo Maeil Olle Market is 5 minutes from the waterfall. Good for tangerine snacks and souvenirs too.

options.name: Negeori Sikdang
options.dish: Hairtail soup (galchi-guk) or sea-urchin soup
options.tip: About 400 m west of the market car park; grilled galchi also comes as a 1-person plate at ₩30,000.
options.why: Naver 4.24 from 4,429 reviews, the most-reviewed sit-down restaurant near the market that opens for Tuesday lunch.

options.name: Deokseongwon
options.dish: Crab jjamppong (spicy seafood noodle soup)
options.tip: Closed only on the 2nd Tuesday (13 Oct), so 20 Oct is open; it's about 550 m south of the market.
options.why: Naver 4.35 from 2,062 reviews, the best score of the sit-down places near the market that open for Tuesday lunch.

options.name: Sambo Sikdang
options.dish: Abalone hotpot (jeonbok-ttukbaegi)
options.tip: 100 m from Negeori Sikdang, so if one has a queue, walk to the other.
options.why: Naver 4.15 from 1,352 reviews; a Seogwipo seafood house that sells abalone hotpot per person.

options.name: Jeseong Jegwa
options.dish: Jeju steamed buns: cream shrimp, red bean or black pork
options.tip: Six of the ten fillings are pork-free; a 3-bun set shared between two makes a snack after lunch.
options.why: Naver 4.69 from 2,824 reviews, the top score of the market stalls checked, and a 2026 blogger's top-four market pick.

options.name: Manong Chicken (Jungang Tongdak)
options.dish: Fried chicken, the only item on the menu
options.tip: Next to the market's public car park (first 30 min free); order first, get a pickup time, then browse.
options.why: Naver 4.3 from 2,566 reviews, and Naver's summary calls it the market's specialty.

stops.name: Afternoon coffee on Aewol Cafe Street
stops.note: Pick a café, then walk the Handam coastal path, about 1.2 km along the lava shore.

options.name: Haejigae
options.dish: Black-sesame latte with a sea view
options.tip: Parking fills after 13:00, so leave the car where you had lunch and walk; desserts can sell out.
options.why: Naver 4.8 from 8,036 reviews; the sea-facing bakery-café at the centre of Aewol Cafe Street.

options.name: Bomnal
options.dish: Tangerine milk tea and carrot cake
options.tip: About 200 m from Haejigae and far cheaper (Americano ₩5,500 against ₩9,000); sit outside for the sea view.
options.why: Diningcode 80, the top-scoring café on its Aewol Cafe Street list, and Naver 4.4 from 7,747; the original Handam café.

options.name: Cheongsudang Aewol
options.dish: Matcha bingsu or strawberry soufflé castella
options.tip: Free parking for 1h30, but cars queue for it after 13:00, so walk over from Cafe Street.
options.why: Naver 4.81 from 1,068 reviews, the highest Naver score of the Aewol cafés checked; dessert-led.

options.name: Aewol The Sunset
options.dish: Truffle wood-fired pizza and coffee
options.tip: At the Gwakji end of the Handam walk, 0.7 km from Bomnal; the pick if you'd rather have pizza than cake.
options.why: Naver 4.39 from 4,539 reviews and Diningcode 74 (4.2 from 35); Naver's summary highlights its truffle pizza.

options.name: Cafe Taehui
options.dish: Coffee, or fish and chips on Gwakji beach
options.tip: Order fish and chips ahead on Naver to skip the frying wait; there's public parking nearby.
options.why: Diningcode 80, #2 on its Gwakji Beach list, and Naver 4.53 from 926 reviews; the cheapest coffee here at ₩4,000.

stops.name: Fill up at S-OIL Seonghwa
stops.note: LOTTE rents its cars with a full tank and wants them back full. This is the station LOTTE suggests, 200 m from the branch. It's self-service: choose 휘발유 (petrol), not 경유 (diesel), then 가득 (full). If the pump declines your card, ask the staff in the office. Open 06:30 to 21:00.

stops.name: Return the car at LOTTE Jeju Autohouse
stops.note: A day ahead of the booked 07:00 Wednesday return, so your last morning is just breakfast and a taxi. Park in the return lot, hand in the key and check you have everything. The branch is open until 23:00.

stops.name: Taxi to the Sheraton, check in and rest
stops.note: If no taxi is waiting at the branch, ride LOTTE's free shuttle to the terminal and take one from the taxi rank there.

stops.name: Dinner in Jeju City
stops.note: Dongmun Market is a 15 to 20-minute walk; its night market opens at 19:00.

options.name: Woojin Haejangguk
options.dish: Bracken yukgaejang, momguk or beef-bone haejangguk
options.tip: Use the main building (the annex shuts on Tuesdays), then walk 0.7 km east to the night market, open from 19:00.
options.why: Diningcode 95, the highest of any Jeju City place checked, and Naver 4.41 from 23,786 reviews; 0.8 km from the hotel.

options.name: Cheongnyeon Minamdeul
options.dish: Garlic-grilled lobster and wood-fired garlic chicken
options.tip: At Dongmun gate 4 and open before the other night stalls start at 19:00; expect a queue for the lobster.
options.why: Naver 4.9 from 1,798 reviews, the top score of the Dongmun stalls checked; its garlic lobster with a fire show is the draw.

options.name: Dongmun Olle Susan
options.dish: Grilled hairtail, deep-sea shrimp sashimi, sea-urchin soup
options.tip: Next to gate 8, where the night-market stalls open at 19:00, so eat here first and browse after.
options.why: Naver 4.56 from 35,234 reviews (likely boosted by a review perk) and Diningcode 78, tagged as a locals' pick.

options.name: Gihoe Hoetjip
options.dish: Mackerel and deep-sea shrimp sashimi
options.tip: 0.7 km from the hotel; it may shut early when the fish runs out, so don't leave it late.
options.why: Naver 4.77 from 303 reviews and Diningcode 74 (4.3); a local-style sashimi house near the black pork street.

options.name: Donhyanggi
options.dish: Black-pork belly and neck, grilled by staff
options.tip: Kimchi stew, steamed egg and cold noodles come free; there's no parking, but it's a walk from the hotel.
options.why: Naver 4.62 from 2,134 reviews, the best Naver score on Jeju City's black pork street.

planB.name: Teddy Bear Museum Jeju
planB.note: Indoor museum 1.8 km from Jusangjeolli, rated 4.7 on Kakao. Price unverified.

planB.name: Jeju Aerospace Museum
planB.note: 2 km from the resort, so on a wet day go after breakfast and use the late check-out. It is shut on Monday 19 Oct (3rd Monday), so Tuesday is the day to go.

planB.name: Arte Museum Jeju
planB.note: Immersive media art 7.6 km from Handam, open until 20:00. Skip it here if you already went on Monday.

planB.name: Nexon Museum
planB.note: Computer museum on the drive into Jeju City, reopened under this name in May 2026. The adult price has risen from 8,000 to 14,000 KRW.

planB.name: National Jeju Museum
planB.note: 2.1 km from Dongmun, with a Kim Young-gap photography exhibition until 1 Mar 2027. Price not stated; the permanent galleries are usually free.

days.title: Fly home
days.note: The car went back on Tuesday, so this morning is breakfast, toilet time and a 10-minute taxi to the airport.

stops.name: Breakfast at the hotel
stops.note: The Daily Social buffet on the 2nd floor opens at 06:30; have your morning coffee here.

stops.name: Toilet time, then check out
stops.note: Ask the front desk the night before to have a taxi ready for 07:30.

stops.name: Check in and go through security
stops.note: You arrive about 1 hour 45 minutes before take-off. Scoot's counters close at 08:30, 60 minutes before departure. If Scoot's app offers online check-in for this flight, do it the day before so you only need the bag drop.

stops.name: Fly home on TR829
stops.note: Scoot TR829, Jeju 09:30 to Singapore 14:35.

ideas.name: Camellia Hill
ideas.note: Pink muhly grass peaks in October, right on your dates. 10 minutes from the Marriott; fits Monday afternoon or a slow Tuesday morning with the late check-out.

ideas.name: Saebyeol Oreum
ideas.note: A volcanic hill covered in silver grass in October. About 30 minutes up. On the way to Aewol on Tuesday.

ideas.name: Sanbangsan & Yongmeori Coast
ideas.note: Layered sandstone cliffs at the foot of Sanbangsan, 5 minutes from Songaksan. The shore path closes at high tide and in rough seas.

ideas.name: Hyeopjae Beach
ideas.note: White sand and emerald water with Biyangdo island offshore. 15 minutes from the Sinchang windmills.

ideas.name: Seopjikoji
ideas.note: A clifftop walk to a small lighthouse with Ilchulbong across the bay. 10 minutes from Playce Camp.

ideas.name: Sangumburi Crater
ideas.note: A wide crater ringed with silver grass in autumn, 3 minutes from Jeju Stone Park.

ideas.name: Yongduam Rock
ideas.note: A dragon-head lava rock on the coast, 5 minutes from the Sheraton.

ideas.name: Iho Tewoo Beach
ideas.note: Red and white horse-shaped lighthouses, best at sunset. 15 minutes from the Sheraton.

ideas.name: Bijarim Forest
ideas.note: An old nutmeg-yew forest on a flat loop path.

checklist.text: Check your hotel bookings match: Playce 17 Oct, Marriott 18–19 Oct, Sheraton 20 Oct
Flights: TW166 in (Sat 17 Oct) and TR829 out (Wed 21 Oct)
Rental car booked and paid: LOTTE, Jeju Autohouse, from Sat 17 Oct 10:00
International Driving Permit and licence for each driver, plus passports and a credit or debit card for LOTTE (no cash)
Check Korea's entry rules (K-ETA) for your passport
eSIM or data plan; install Naver Map and Kakao Map
Some cash in won, plus a T-money card
Torch, if you pick the Ilchulbong sunset climb on Day 1
Passports handy on Sun 18 Oct for the Udo ferry form
LOTTE's online pre-check-in (the 'fill out' link in the booking email), so pickup is quicker
